species: Forty-five human CSF specimens from 16 patients were procured under written informed consent in accordance with the Belmont Report and the Declaration of Helsinki.
disease_state: Here, we performed a multi-omics analysis of the CSF from LMM patients to determine how the leptomeningeal microenvironment shapes the biology and therapeutic responses of melanoma cells.
sample_source: CSF samples were analyzed by mass spectrometry and incubated with melanoma cells, that were subjected to RNA-Seq analysis.
anatomic_site_tumor: The development of leptomeningeal melanoma metastases (LMM) is a rare and devastating complication of the late-stage disease, for which no effective treatments exist.
